name: caffeinity-skills
description: Caffeinity skills marketplace: editing, teaching, recruiting, SEO, release-preflight, decision review, skill authoring and tuning, and multi-agent tournament plugins.

plugins.name: wordsmith
plugins.description: Teaches your agent to edit, not just generate: 44 commands across 5 disciplines that tighten, rewrite, critique and proofread while keeping the author's meaning, hedges and voice intact.

plugins.name: recruiter-lens
plugins.description: Reviews resumes, CVs and LinkedIn profiles the way recruiters screen them: first-impression scans, ATS compatibility, rejection-pattern diagnosis and interview prep. Never invents a metric.

plugins.name: topic-primer
plugins.description: A world-class teacher for any topic, from zero background toward expert depth, in eight modes from foundations and curricula to strict exams and ELI5.

plugins.name: do-better
plugins.description: When an answer is bad, runs a single-elimination tournament of sub-agents with different strategy cards until one solution survives.

plugins.name: keyword-guard
plugins.description: Plans topic clusters and kills keyword cannibalization so exactly one page wins each query, with a mandatory cannibalization audit before content changes.

plugins.name: seo-crawl
plugins.description: Crawls a site you own and returns deterministic, evidence-backed technical SEO findings: indexability, canonicals, titles, metas, H1s, broken internal links, sitemap coverage and static JSON-LD. Bounded and read-only; blocked or unrun checks are reported INCONCLUSIVE, never a pass. Feeds seo-audit and keyword-guard.

plugins.name: web-preflight
plugins.description: Checks a site you own before you ship it, treating status codes as signals rather than findings; unrun checks are reported as INCONCLUSIVE, never a pass.

plugins.name: applicant-kit
plugins.description: Produces tailored job-application material: decoded JD table, action-task-result-impact bullet rewrites, honest keyword placement map, five role-specific summaries, full LinkedIn rewrite, and a 20-question interview answer pack. Sibling of recruiter-lens: it produces while recruiter-lens judges. Never invents experience or numbers.

plugins.name: findable
plugins.description: Sets up discovery for a GitHub repo, agent skill, Claude Code plugin or MCP server so people and agents find it by what it does, not just its name: audits current visibility and same-name collisions, derives the queries strangers actually type, drafts the About text, topics, README opening, release notes and a project page, then plans directories and a dated re-check. Never games stars or leaves example slots with invented output.

plugins.name: application-pilot
plugins.description: Runs the job search around the applications: search brief, role discovery with honest posting dates, rubric-based fit scoring, a reviewable CSV or Markdown tracker, follow-up drafts, interview briefings and a funnel review. Never submits, invents nothing, and has no CLI, telemetry, or browser automation. Coordinates with applicant-kit and recruiter-lens.

plugins.name: crash-test
plugins.description: Crash-tests a decision before you build it. Four fixed roles (Pragmatist, Skeptic, Specialist, Contrarian) draft the same task in separate contexts, attack each other's drafts anonymously, and a chair merges what survived, keeps a dissent log, and grounds the winner's claims against your source before adopting it. Optional Operator seat for cost, rollout and reversibility. No server, no API keys, no other agent CLIs.

plugins.name: pre-ship-performance-audit
plugins.description: Audits and fixes web app performance before launch: four read-only subagent audits over twenty known slow-downs across images, fonts, bundles, database queries and servers, then same-condition mobile Lighthouse medians prove each fix. Never removes a feature for a score; asks before dependency, index, RLS or region changes.

plugins.name: pre-ship-security-red-team
plugins.description: Authorized, evidence-driven red-team pass over a web app you own, before launch. Three read-only subagents run 14 authorization and abuse checks against isolated synthetic accounts, the chair fixes each failure, adds regression tests, and reruns with a negative control. Isolated local environments only; secrets masked in every artifact; anything unrun is reported not-proven, never passed.

plugins.name: publish-release-gate
plugins.description: Publishes a skill through three distribution channels: marketplace plugin, agent discovery protocol, and tarball delivery via Cloudflare Pages custom domain. Use when someone says 'publish to marketplace', 'make discoverable by agents', 'deploy skill site', or after completing a skill update that needs public distribution.

plugins.name: release-gate
plugins.description: Runs three pre-launch passes (exposure, app-tests, perf) in sequence and returns one release posture — HOLD or ready — with three separate verdicts and one merged finding register. Deterministic arithmetic over union of findings; a lane that did not run holds the gate. Use when asked 'is this safe to ship', 'ready to deploy', or for go/no-go decisions before any production release.

plugins.name: upstream-check
plugins.description: Audits local git clones against their upstream before you push. Fetches first, classifies each repo as level, push-ready, behind or diverged, screens the unpushed diff for secrets, and only pushes with an explicit --push. A second script compares your published listings against the repos that actually ship a SKILL.md. Never force-pushes; a behind or diverged repo is reported, not touched.

plugins.name: draft-skill
plugins.description: Creates a new agent skill from a plain idea. Confirms the purpose before writing anything, checks the already-installed siblings for overlap, splits the work between scripts, references and assets, writes a description that actually triggers, then validates with tune-skill's check_skill.py and hands off for the boundary check. Original authoring skill: it contains no text from Qoder's built-in skill-creator, which ships without a licence permitting redistribution.

plugins.name: prompts-to-skill
plugins.description: Turns a list of your own prompts into a finished, tested agent skill, one skill per prompt. Interviews for intent, checks what is already installed so the new skill does not duplicate it, drafts with draft-skill, writes trigger test cases including near-misses, then gates the result with tune-skill. Requires draft-skill and tune-skill and stops with a clear message when either is missing. Does not do the release packaging.

plugins.name: prompts-to-skill-release
plugins.description: Packages a finished agent skill for release: runs its trigger test cases and records exactly which passed and which did not, sets the version and CHANGELOG, builds the archive, writes the README, and ends with a per-platform install checklist. Failed tests stay visible in the report instead of being dropped from it. Assumes the skill is already authored, by prompts-to-skill or draft-skill.

plugins.name: tune-skill
plugins.description: Audits and fine-tunes an agent skill that already exists: the description that never fires, overlap with installed siblings, stale names and counts, and handoff contracts that do not hand off. Ships check_skill.py, a deterministic SKILL.md validator covering frontmatter, folder and heading agreement, description length, reference paths that do not exist, and count phrases that go stale. Not for creating a skill from an idea; that is draft-skill.

plugins.name: publish-pipeline
plugins.description: Owns the machine that turns skill repos into a published site: one committed manifest as the publication decision, discovery that opens a pull request, a generated page per new skill, both discovery indexes, a sitemap, and gates that fail closed before and after the deploy. Not for releasing one skill through the marketplace or tarball channels; that is publish-release-gate.

plugins.name: cold-email-ops
plugins.description: Plans and audits a cold-email program at volume: inbox and domain capacity from a monthly send target, reply-rate floors by domain, burn replacement, shadow-ban tests, automation error budgets and per-client reporting. Thresholds stay labelled as source benchmarks, and missing data returns INCONCLUSIVE rather than a pass. Not for pre-load list QA; that is cold-email-list-gate.

plugins.name: cold-email-list-gate
plugins.description: Gates a cold-email lead list before it loads: samples ten rows against the ICP, returns GO or HOLD with the fail pattern and the re-run condition, and compares data providers on the same criteria. Not for lists that already sent; that diagnosis is cold-email-ops.
